race.title: Paddy Power Intermediate Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: MONEYGARROW hardly damaged his stock when eighth in the Albert Bartlett here in March and looks very interesting tackling handicap company for the first time. He gets the nod over Daylatedollarshort , whose Silver Trophy form is proving strong, with Sunny South West , Hillberry Hill and A King Of Magic all lurking on potentially handy marks. MONEYGARROW (IRE) DAYLATEDOLLARSHORT (IRE) SUNNY SOUTH WEST (IRE)
